svg.text: Which service depends on what at runtime: REST clients (*.host properties), Kafka, datastores and external APIs. Read a row to see a service’s dependencies; read a column to see its blast radius.
• mdms, egov-user, workflow and hrms contracts are
platform-wide: test across all consumers on change.
• health-facility-registry is the most-used E4H API —
treat its search contract as stable/public.
most E4H services: deploy them after their deps.
Kafka topics, ES indices, external integrations

Source: *.host / *.endpoint properties in backend/**/src/main/resources/application.properties, app/utils/*_client.py (ingestion-service), @KafkaListener classes, *-persister.yml. Last updated 2026-10-23.
